description: API, Streamlit UI, evaluation script, Docker/CI infrastructure, and README. Depends on all prior FEATs (api/main.py imports every src module; app/app.py surfaces all ML and agent features). Build in order: api -> app -> eval -> Dockerfile -> docker-compose -> ci.yml -> README. Final step: run full test suite to confirm everything integrates.
steps: Write api/main.py. At top: from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv(). Create FastAPI app with title='ClaimGuard AI', version='1.0.0'. Add CORSMiddleware (origins=['*'] for dev). Add RBACMiddleware. Define lazy singletons for UnderwritingEngine, FraudDetectionEngine, PolicyVectorStore (instantiated on first request, not at startup, to avoid blocking). Routes: GET /health (public, returns {status:ok, version:1.0.0}). POST /underwrite (Depends require_role(['analyst','admin']), Depends rate_limit_dependency): body=UnderwritingFeatures, returns UnderwritingResult. POST /claims/score (same auth): body=ClaimFeatures, returns FraudScoringResult. POST /copilot/decide (same auth): body={query:str, context_type:str, features:dict, session_id:str}, returns CopilotState result. GET /graph/collusion-rings (same auth): query param csv_path defaults to data/sample_claims.csv, returns list[CollusionRing]. GET /compliance (Depends require_role(['admin','analyst','viewer'])): returns ComplianceReport. GET /metrics (Depends require_role(['admin'])): returns prometheus_client.generate_latest() as text/plain or {message:'prometheus not installed'}. Add structured JSON logging using Python logging with a JSON formatter on each request. Use X-API-Key header via Depends(get_api_key) where get_api_key reads Header(None, alias='X-API-Key').

Write app/app.py. Top: import streamlit as st; from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv(). Use st.set_page_config(page_title='ClaimGuard AI', layout='wide'). Create tabs with st.tabs(['Explorer','Underwrite','Claims','Policy Copilot','Graph Intel','HITL','Observability','Compliance']). Explorer tab: load sample_claims.csv and sample_policies.csv with pandas, show st.dataframe, show Plotly bar chart of claim_type distribution and fraud_label pie chart. Underwrite tab: st.form with inputs for all UnderwritingFeatures fields; on submit call UnderwritingEngine().predict(); show risk_score as plotly gauge (0-1 range), risk_tier as colored badge, SHAP drivers as Plotly waterfall bar chart. Claims tab: same pattern for ClaimFeatures -> FraudDetectionEngine.predict() -> fraud_score gauge + SHAP bar chart. Policy Copilot tab: st.text_input for query, st.selectbox for context_type; on submit call run_copilot (or fallback); display decision_draft in st.info box, retrieved docs in st.expander, HITL badge (st.warning('Queued for human review')) always shown. Graph Intel tab: run GraphCollusionDetector().analyze() on sample_claims.csv, render Plotly network graph using networkx for layout (spring_layout), show rings table with st.dataframe. HITL tab: show hitl_queue.get_pending() in st.dataframe; for each pending item show Approve/Reject/Escalate buttons with analyst notes text_area; button click calls hitl_queue.review(). Observability tab: try to get metrics from prometheus_client; show counters as st.metric cards and latency histogram as Plotly bar; fall back to mock values if prometheus_client not available. Compliance tab: call generate_compliance_report(); show overall_score as Plotly gauge; show controls breakdown as Plotly pie (compliant/partial/non_compliant); show each control as st.expander with evidence and remediation text.

Write eval/ragas_eval.py. Define 5 QA triples as plain dicts: (1) Q: 'What is the claim settlement timeline under IRDAI regulations?' A: references 30-day rule. (2) Q: 'What documents are required for a motor insurance claim?' A: references policy wording procedure. (3) Q: 'Are pre-existing conditions covered?' A: references exclusions section. (4) Q: 'What is the free-look period?' A: references 15-30 days. (5) Q: 'Can I port my health insurance policy?' A: references portability rights. Import guard: try: from ragas import evaluate; from ragas.metrics import context_precision, context_recall, faithfulness, answer_relevancy; HAS_RAGAS=True; except ImportError: HAS_RAGAS=False. If HAS_RAGAS: run evaluate() with the 5 triples and print results table. Else: print a mock results table with plausible scores (0.7-0.9 range) and a note that ragas is not installed. Script runs as __main__.

Write Dockerfile. Multi-stage: stage 1 (builder): FROM python:3.11-slim as builder; WORKDIR /build; COPY requirements.txt .; RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --user -r requirements.txt. Stage 2 (final): FROM python:3.11-slim; WORKDIR /app; COPY --from=builder /root/.local /root/.local; COPY . .; ENV PATH=/root/.local/bin:$PATH; ENV PYTHONPATH=/app; EXPOSE 8000 8501; CMD ["uvicorn", "api.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"].

Write docker-compose.yml with services: api (build:., command: uvicorn api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000, ports:8000:8000, env_file:.env, depends_on:postgres,neo4j, healthcheck: GET /health), frontend (build:., command: streamlit run app/app.py --server.port 8501 --server.address 0.0.0.0, ports:8501:8501, env_file:.env), postgres (image:postgres:15, env POSTGRES_DB/USER/PASSWORD, volume postgres_data, healthcheck: pg_isready), neo4j (image:neo4j:5, ports:7474/7687, env NEO4J_AUTH, volume neo4j_data), prometheus (image:prom/prometheus:latest, volume ./prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml, ports:9090:9090), grafana (image:grafana/grafana:latest, ports:3000:3000, depends_on:prometheus, volume grafana_data). Also write a minimal prometheus.yml scrape config that scrapes the api service at :8000/metrics every 15s.

Write .github/workflows/ci.yml. On: push and pull_request to main branch. Jobs: test (runs-on: ubuntu-latest). Steps: checkout (actions/checkout@v4), setup-python 3.11 (actions/setup-python@v5), cache pip (actions/cache@v4 on ~/.cache/pip keyed to requirements.txt hash), install deps (pip install -r requirements.txt), generate data (python data/synthetic_generator.py), run tests (pytest tests/ -v --tb=short). No secrets required — all fallbacks active in CI.

Write README.md with: (1) Title + badges (Python 3.11, FastAPI, Streamlit, License MIT). (2) One-paragraph overview of ClaimGuard AI. (3) ASCII architecture diagram showing data flow: Policy Docs / Claims CSV -> Vector Store / ML Models -> LangGraph Pipeline -> FastAPI -> Streamlit UI, with HITL queue and Prometheus sidecar. (4) Quick Start — Docker section: git clone, cp .env.example .env, docker compose up --build; and Local section: pip install -r requirements.txt, python data/synthetic_generator.py, uvicorn api.main:app --port 8000 &, streamlit run app/app.py. (5) Environment variables table with columns Name/Description/Required/Default. (6) API Reference table: Method/Path/Auth/Description for all 7 endpoints. (7) UI Tabs section: one sentence per tab. (8) Compliance section: brief note on 10 IRDAI controls tracked. (9) Evaluation section: describe RAGAS eval script and how to run it. (10) Tech Stack section: two-column table.
acceptance_criteria: python eval/ragas_eval.py exits 0 (with or without ragas installed)
pytest tests/ -v --tb=short passes all 4 test files
verification: python -c "from api.main import app; print('api import OK')"
